title: Smart Home Security Tips and Gifts for New Homeowners
summary: Moving into a new home? Here's how you can keep it safe with some security gifts for new homeowners.
body_markdown:
After getting moved in and settled, it’s a great opportunity to take stock of your house and the surrounding property and determine the areas that could benefit most from a security camera.


Look for major entry points (the front door, the back door, windows, the garage, etc.) and find the best places to install a camera that will give you the best coverage of that room or area. Utilize wide angles for large outdoor areas so you can capture more square footage with a single camera. Also, check blind spots like side yards or behind external structures as well as chokepoints like hallways and determine whether it would be worth installing a camera in those areas to round out your setup.


Once the physical installation is done, you can tie everything together by logging into the accompanying smart home security app. This simple yet powerful piece of software will allow you to check on all of your feeds, make sure everything is running smoothly, and even notify you if your grid notices anything suspicious.
